description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component, verifying its behavior in various onboarding scenarios.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of the OnboardingStateStore component.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that the onboarding should be presented on a fresh app launch when not connected.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding is not presented if the app is connected.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Verifies that marking the onboarding as completed persists the mode, and it affects the presentation logic accordingly.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Checks that the first run introduction is shown initially and then persists as seen.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Ensures that calling reset clears onboarding completion and first run intro flags.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a new UserDefaults suite for testing with a unique identifier.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes the persistent domain for the specified UserDefaults suite to reset its state.
